Absolutely. For the best result, pair jeans with pieces that balance the silhouette.

If you go with a straight-leg style, fitted or cropped tops work well, and blazers or denim jackets add polish. Sneakers keep it casual, while ankle boots, loafers, or heels dress it up.

If you choose a wider or more relaxed fit, a tucked-in or more fitted top usually works best to keep the shape balanced 🙂
